source_statement_summary: All I/O artifacts must be suitably persisted in repositories and, at suitable granularity and relevance, machine-evidenced and routed to Zenodo and where applicable IETF in a fully automated manner.

deterministic IETF eligibility routing for protocol/interoperability results
automated retryable continuation toward credentialed external effects
